dossier_meta.paper: Graph Isomorphism for $(H_1,H_2)$-free Graphs: An Almost Complete Dicho…
dossier_meta.statement_text: Is it possible to determine the computational complexity of Graph Isomorphism for $(H_1, H_2)$-free graphs for all pairs $H_1, H_2$?
dossier_meta.context_text: Kratsch and Schweitzer [22] initiated the classification of Graph Isomorphism for $(H_1,H_2)$-free graphs, and Schweitzer [30] later proved that only finitely many cases remain open without specifying them. This question frames the paper's programme to complete the dichotomy.
